_comment: Single source of the brand and emoji of every AI backend. The tray's model button reads '<emoji> <model>' from here on Windows, macOS and Linux, the Backend submenu names an option '<brand> <emoji>', and the model selector page uses the same emoji in its backend filter and table. Brands and emojis are not translated; tools/test/test-llm-backend-brands-single-source.cjs forbids a second copy.
